messages:
anya: Heads-up — we're designing the GCP Cloud KMS integration pattern for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem packages). Quick questions + suggestions below, looking for ops/security input.

anya: Requirements: customer-managed KMS (not Redwood-hosted keys), support cross-project keyrings, allow SA impersonation from runtime, detailed audit logs, and safe key rotation with minimal downtime.

kevin: 👍 high-level: prefer a dedicated KMS project per-customer or per-org? tradeoffs on blast radius vs. onboarding complexity.

marisol: For regulated customers we recommend a separate GCP project owned by them when possible. If not, create a dedicated Redwood-managed KMS project per customer to isolate keys and IAM.

anya: Proposal draft:
- Key ring in a single location chosen by customer (multi-region only if they need it)
- Create a single crypto key (KMS) with automatic rotation (rotationPeriod set)
- Redwood runtime uses a short-lived service account impersonation to call KMS (no long-lived key material stored)
- Use envelope encryption: runtime generates DEKs, encrypts with Cloud KMS primary key.

kevin: IAM specifics?

marisol: Minimal IAM to grant crossing-project access:
1) On KMS key (or key-level): roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter granted to runtime SA principal.
2) If using impersonation pattern: grant roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on the target SA to the caller SA (or use workload identity federation for GKE on-prem).
3) Limit the member to the exact service account: member:serviceAccount:run-sa@redwood-customer.iam.gserviceaccount.com

anya: Example CLI for key binding (replace values):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding my-key --location=us-east1 --keyring=my-kr \
  --member=serviceAccount:run-sa@redwood-customer.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

kevin: And to allow impersonation:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding target-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member=serviceAccount:caller-sa@other-proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```

marisol: Important: avoid granting roles/cloudkms.admin broadly. Key-level roles are preferred. Also use IAM conditions if we can restrict by resource name or request attributes.

engsec-bot: Note: Cloud KMS Data Access audit logs are disabled by default. To log encrypt/decrypt calls, enable Data Access audit logs for the project/org and export to a sink (BigQuery/LogBucket).

anya: Good call. We should enable both AdminActivity and DataAccess for the KMS project and create a LogSink to BigQuery for retention + alerting. Also tag logs with customer id for filtering.

kevin: Rotation flow question — how do we handle DEKs encrypted under an old key version when primary rotates?

marisol: Two options:
- Use KMS key versions and set a new primary. Existing ciphertexts remain decryptable by older key versions until disabled. Then run a background rewrap job that decrypts (via KMS) and re-encrypts DEKs under the new primary.
- Or generate new DEKs and re-encrypt application blobs lazily on access (safer for large datasets).

anya: I prefer lazy rewrap for customer data to avoid huge batch jobs, but we need a migration worker for cold data. Document tradeoffs.

sre-oncall: Ops note: make sure we have fallback keys/variants for outage scenarios. Policy: fallback to a secondary key in another region (and test cross-region decrypt latency).

kevin: Action items:
- marisol to write an RFC with the recommended IAM bindings, audit config, and rotation plan (POC steps) — due EOD Friday
- anya to add sample gcloud commands and a small node/python snippet showing envelope encrypt/decrypt using KMS
- sre-oncall to draft an outage/fallback test plan

marisol: I'll include a sample minimal terraform and an example gcloud policy snippet.

anya: thanks. if folks agree we can spin up a small PoC (redwood-test project) and validate impersonation + DataAccess logging.

kevin: agree. :thumbsup:

engsec-bot: Reminder: create an access review ticket for the runtime SA once we land the final role list.

anya: noted. I'll create a docs page in the private-kms-runbook once RFC is merged.
